the ex-acquisition ratio converging toward the reported ratio

the aggregate stability masks a shift toward the legacy book

GAAP earnings and pre-provision revenue lines higher in the later quarter, with a lower credit loss provision and slightly lower total noninterest expense, while company-defined adjusted net income also rose
the allowance balance and allowance-to-loans coverage declined, gross charge-offs increased, and both the reported and the company-defined ex-acquisition annualized net charge-off ratios rose

notes: Diagnostic high within this selected-source case, not independent finance-expert validation. The answer correctly reads signed charge-offs by magnitude, distinguishes point-in-time NPA stocks from quarterly flows and annualized ratios, separates GAAP from adjusted net income, and treats a lower provision as insufficient proof of improved credit quality. It also recognizes the Q2-only acquisition-date PCD charge-off context without treating it as a comparable Q3 zero. Maintain/unchanged conviction matches the available ledger and is bounded to a mixed earnings-credit reading; a fuller reserve audit remains needed before a stronger credit-quality conclusion.
